about.text: Ladotyri Mytilinis is a hard PDO cheese from Lesbos, Greece, preserved in extra virgin olive oil. It is made from sheep milk or sheep with at most 30 % goat milk and has been produced since ancient times.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Sheep, or sheep with at most 30 % goat; from local animals fed on local flora
At least 40 % fat in dry matter; at most 38 % moisture
Cylinders about 10 cm across and high, around 1.5 kg
